European Heritage Days
On Saturday, September 19, and Sunday, September 20, join us for the European Heritage Days and discover the history and rich heritage of Université PSL's institutions. Mines Paris - PSL, the École nationale supérieure d’architecture Paris-Malaquais – PSL, the Paris Observatory - PSL, the Collège de France, the Curie Museum, and the École nationale des chartes - PSL are opening their doors to offer you tours, games, lectures, book signings, and many other opportunities for discovery!
September 19-20, 2026
